name: Pointing The Finger At Others
overview: Scripture warns against self-righteousness and unjust judgment, reminding believers that most will claim their own goodness, yet true faithfulness is rare (Proverbs 20:6). Jesus teaches not to judge others lest we be judged ourselves (Matthew 7:1), while calling His followers to a higher standard of love and grace, modeled after His own example (John 1:14; John 13:34). Believers are called to confront sin boldly but with humility, as seen in Isaiah's command to expose transgressions without hypocrisy (Isaiah 58:1), and to maintain their spiritual influence by living authentically as salt of the earth (Matthew 5:13).
